subject: Television & Streaming
title: Live Aid and Television Charity
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Live Aid and Television Charity.

hook.text: In 1985, Live Aid broadcast simultaneously from London and Philadelphia to 1.9 billion viewers.

buildup.text: Bob Geldof organized the concert after seeing BBC footage of starving children.

discovery.text: The broadcast raised over 125 million dollars.

twist.text: Critics later revealed much of the aid was misused by the Ethiopian government.

climax.text: Live Aid created the template for televised charity: massive spectacle, emotional appeal, and messy consequences.

punchline.text: Television saved lives and taught a lesson about saving lives.

quiz.question: What was a major criticism of Live Aid despite its massive fundraising success?
options: Much of the aid was misused by the Ethiopian government
